inference_rule: Frozen historical ddof=0 scaler + stored PCA loadings + nearest validated 7D centroid
cohort_relative_feature_rule: For a newly canonicalized project, rank/state-share/company-count are calculated on the current ecosystem universe. Scaler, PCA loadings and validated-cluster centroids stay frozen to the 36-row reference.
governance: Structural cluster assignment only; not a risk class, bank rating, PD, LGD, EAD or ECL.
No automatic credit approval or rejection.
Out-of-distribution distance triggers review rather than an invented risk score.
Historical feature matrix is treated as the authoritative model input contract.
